engine_contract.evaluate: f(inputs, overrides) -> all node values; deterministic; pure
engine_contract.incremental: re-evaluate only nodes downstream of changed cells (slider target < 10 ms)
engine_contract.vectorised: every expression is elementwise arithmetic; evaluate a batch of N input vectors at once (IF -> where, MAX -> maximum). Monte Carlo and finite differences use this.
engine_contract.derivatives: finite differences on the vectorised engine, or forward-mode AD over the AST. IF/MAX/MIN make kinks: use subgradients and multi-start.

decision_variable_sets.lever_intensity: scalar lever inputs that vary by scenario (lev.Lxx.*), bounds = [registry min, min(registry max, stretch cap)]; stretch cap default = max(C, D) preset value
decision_variable_sets.lever_timing: lev.start[lever] integer 1-12 (lower bound = earliest feasible), lev.ramp[lever]

problems.label: Solve one input for a target
problems.method: Brent / bisection after a monotonicity scan (11 points); report 'not reachable within range' with the closest value
problems.ui: right-click any input: 'what value closes the gap?'

problems.label: What it takes, lever by lever
problems.do: goal_seek each lever-intensity input alone until res.gap = 0; list value needed vs range

problems.label: Blend two scenarios
problems.do: x = A + lambda (B - A) over all scenario-varying inputs; solve lambda for res.gap = 0

problems.label: Minimum-risk lever mix that clears the bar

objective_options.min_change: sum_i ((x_i - x0_i) / range_i)^2  (closest to the current plan)

constraints.gcc_hiring (optional): res.fte_gcc - hc.gcc <= hiring capacity (default 500 in CY27)

methods.explainable (default in UI): greedy marginal analysis: repeatedly take the step with the best constraint gain per unit of added risk; output is an ordered list of moves
methods.production: SLSQP or IPOPT with finite-difference gradients from the vectorised engine, 8 multi-starts; CMA-ES fallback when non-smooth
methods.with lever_switch: MINLP via branch on lev.on (17 binaries) or penalty relaxation

problems.output: new scenario (kind=solver) + ranked move list + binding constraints + shadow prices

problems.label: Frontier: savings vs risk (or vs one-time cost)
problems.do: epsilon-constraint sweep of min_risk_mix over bar levels 100..200 step 5
problems.output: curve points + the scenario at each point

problems.label: Plan where every VP clears its own bar
problems.do: min_risk_mix with per_vp constraints; if infeasible, maximise min_v vp.coverage[v]

problems.label: Probability of hitting the target

default_distributions.lev.realize[l]: 1.2 x Beta(a = K conf_l / 1.2, b = K (1 - conf_l / 1.2)), K = 4 (mean = confidence)
default_distributions.user_defined: variable_def.dist overrides: triangular, PERT, normal, lognormal, discrete

problems.correlation: Gaussian copula; lever families (labour L01-L08, tech L09-L16) rho = 0.5; editable correlation groups
outputs: P10/P50/P90 of res.net, res.bar, res.gap, br.eps27, val.px

methods.tornado: one-at-a-time to registry min/max (or +/- x%), sorted by swing on res.net / res.gap / br.eps27
methods.elasticity: d output / d input x input / output at current point
methods.sobol: Saltelli sampling, N = 1024, top 20 inputs from tornado; first-order and total indices
